facts.fact: Prime Minister Abd Alhameed Aldabaiba approved the National Strategy for the Communications and Informatics sector 2023-2027, which aims at communications for all at fair prices; the article states no broadband targets and gives no approval date apart from its own publication date of 2023-05-03.
